class.name: OpenXRAndroidGeospatialExtension
class.description: Wraps the [code]XR_ANDROID_geospatial[/code] extension, which provides precise geo-location and orientation using a combination of motion tracking, GPS and other sensors, and Google's Visual Positioning System (VPS). This can provide sub-meter positional accuracy and sub-degree orientation accuracy. Authentication must be configured via [OpenXRAndroidGoogleCloudAuthExtension] before using this extension.

method.name: check_vps_availability
method.description: Checks whether VPS (Visual Positioning System) data is available at the given latitude and longitude. Returns an [OpenXRFutureResult] whose result value is [enum VpsAvailability]. When VPS is unavailable, geospatial tracking accuracy may be lower at that location. You can call [method get_geographic_location] to get the latitude and longitude to use here.

method.name: geospatial_pose_to_transform
method.description: Converts an [OpenXRAndroidGeospatialPose] to a [Transform3D] in the current play space. The geospatial tracker must be in the [constant GEOSPATIAL_STATE_RUNNING] state.

method.name: get_geographic_location
method.description: Gets the devices's geographic location using normal Android APIs, not VPS. The given callback will be called with three arguments: [code](success: bool, latitude: float, longitude: float)[/code] This method is helpful for getting a latitude and longitude to call [method check_vps_availability]

method.name: get_geospatial_state
method.description: Returns the current state of the geospatial tracker.

method.name: is_geospatial_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the [code]XR_ANDROID_geospatial[/code] extension is supported by the OpenXR runtime.

method.name: start_geospatial
method.description: Creates the geospatial tracker, which tracks the device's position and orientation relative to the Earth. You must call [method is_geospatial_supported] first to verify that the extension is supported. The tracker initially enters the [constant GEOSPATIAL_STATE_STOPPED] state, and the application must wait for the [signal openxr_android_geospatial_state_changed] signal to indicate [constant GEOSPATIAL_STATE_RUNNING] before using pose conversion methods.

method.name: stop_geospatial
method.description: Destroys the geospatial tracker and stops geospatial tracking.

method.name: transform_to_geospatial_pose
method.description: Converts a [Transform3D] in the current play space to an [OpenXRAndroidGeospatialPose] containing latitude, longitude, altitude, and east-up-south orientation. The returned pose includes accuracy information: check [method OpenXRAndroidGeospatialPose.is_position_valid] and [method OpenXRAndroidGeospatialPose.is_orientation_valid] before reading the corresponding fields. The geospatial tracker must be in the [constant GEOSPATIAL_STATE_RUNNING] state.

signal.name: openxr_android_geospatial_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the geospatial tracker state changes. See [enum GeospatialState] for possible values.
